lines.text: It's quiz time! Three questions. Find the bot your clinic needs!
Question one! Do new patients still fill out paper forms in the waiting room?
Question two! Do patients forget their follow-up appointments?
Question three! Does your front desk type the same information in twice?
Said yes even once? Your bot is the intake and reminder bot. Forms done before patients arrive, and reminders sent for you.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Drop your score in the comments. You're still the captain.
